name: Deserted Wives
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity and covenantal nature of marriage, emphasizing that God witnesses the faithfulness due to one's spouse, as seen in Malachi 2:14. Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:32 that divorcing a wife except for fornication leads to adultery, highlighting the serious consequences of desertion. Hebrews 13:4 further affirms that marriage is honorable and pure, warning that God will judge those who violate its sacredness through unfaithfulness or adultery.
